response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders) AS share FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id), r AS (SELECT customer_id, order_count, share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (share IS NULL), share DESC) AS rnk FROM c) SELECT customer_id, order_count, share FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY (share IS NULL), share DESC
